g.text: Chapter 25 on one page: the practice loop
drill, record, log, mock, re-attempt, with one rubric throughout
practise the lowest-scoring criterion on purpose
bar: 60% of the total (21/35 or 24/40), and no criterion at 1
interview-ready: 4+ on every criterion across three mocks in a row
fixed clock, same rubric, one table: progress shows over weeks
